status: Human-authored source ledger, not an atomic rule count or automated semantic proof

entries.first_nonempty_line: # AGENTS.md
entries.requirement_zh: 阅读相关分目录说明，依最近目录优先级；命令从仓库根运行

entries.first_nonempty_line: This repo is a harness for a specific experiment:
entries.requirement_zh: 以用户顺序参考为行为规范，保持前端和适配器兼容

entries.first_nonempty_line: Variants are **platform-partitioned**. Emit yours under
entries.requirement_zh: 平台分目录、注册平台 launch；共享 dispatcher 不改；默认 attention auto；用 paths 工具而非数父目录

entries.first_nonempty_line: ## Your mission
entries.requirement_zh: 默认同时优化首输出延迟和持续速率，流式时保留平滑性约束

entries.first_nonempty_line: 1. **Latency to first output (per request).** For a given user input
entries.requirement_zh: 多输入统计首输出延迟中位数和 p95

entries.first_nonempty_line: streaming output, the system has to keep emitting chunks
entries.requirement_zh: 稳态输入速率扫描；流式记录输出间隔中位数、p95、超预算比例；单输出时指标合并

entries.first_nonempty_line: ### Per-app overrides
entries.requirement_zh: 用户指定指标优先，默认指标作为次要约束和证据；未指定不自造目标

entries.first_nonempty_line: You are free to reorganize compute, rearrange scheduling, redistribute
entries.requirement_zh: 变换保留依赖与各运算消费的值，仅允许浮点归约噪声

entries.first_nonempty_line: ### Two distinct optimization layers
entries.requirement_zh: 探索应用调度和可见模型内部两层；不把分析器输出当机会的上限；含各层独立及组合方案

entries.first_nonempty_line: ### Device placement is yours to decide
entries.requirement_zh: 自行分析设备分配，比较代价、内存、通信和重叠，不能照抄参考配置

entries.first_nonempty_line: ## Environment
entries.requirement_zh: 开始时确定用户指定或 flashrt 环境，否则询问；全程同一解释器，子进程用 sys.executable

entries.first_nonempty_line: PATH.
entries.requirement_zh: 根目录运行；多卡前确认资源；复用已配置权重路径

entries.first_nonempty_line: ### Read-only (treat as a hard contract)
entries.requirement_zh: 参考、适配器、前端、IR、共享运行库、资源、内核和顶层文件只读；前端不可执行

entries.first_nonempty_line: ### Writable (your workspace)
entries.requirement_zh: 从模板复制工作目录；产物写指定 app 后端，模板不改

entries.first_nonempty_line: ## Frontend compatibility contract
entries.requirement_zh: 并读适配器和参考，匹配缓冲区、控制码、形状、类型、节奏及会话生命周期

entries.first_nonempty_line: ### Phase 1: IR conversion
entries.requirement_zh: 完整可见计算建 worker 图和各可见模型图；黑箱只调度；声明流式、状态范围及速率转换

entries.first_nonempty_line: Each operator's **implementation lives on the operator itself** — you
entries.requirement_zh: 算子自带实现；状态访问声明；原地修改须声明写；图和算子在工作区
entries.evaluation_proposal_zh: 原执行器部分约束、审阅

entries.first_nonempty_line: ### Phase 2: IR validation
entries.requirement_zh: 实跑 SequentialExecutor 和同输入参考，逐块数值比较；容差注明理由；未通过不能部署

entries.first_nonempty_line: clear PASS / FAIL verdict to stdout, and you must read that verdict
entries.requirement_zh: 验证后运行图分析，日志保留流水阶段、重叠、关键路径、独立对

entries.first_nonempty_line: ### Phase 3: Deployment
entries.requirement_zh: 部署由分析推导，完成设备通信和合法重叠，保留适配器契约

entries.first_nonempty_line: ### Phase 4: Validation and iteration
entries.requirement_zh: 至少十个不同优化方案，修 bug 不算另一个方案

entries.first_nonempty_line: **There is no session deadline.** Take the time the full queue
entries.requirement_zh: 无自定会话期限；十个为下限；覆盖不同策略、独立与组合；所有队列项需处理

entries.first_nonempty_line: **Implementation and debugging cost are never valid rationale for
entries.requirement_zh: 实现调试成本不得成为跳过、替代或轮换理由；当前方案先到终态

entries.first_nonempty_line: **Read-only areas are not a blocker — vendor the file into your
entries.requirement_zh: 只读代码需改时复制到工作区，注明来源和分歧原因，未改路径数值对照

entries.first_nonempty_line: **Terminal statuses.** A queue entry reaches a terminal status only
entries.requirement_zh: measured 须真实端到端、正确性判决及日志、benchmark；另两终态为狭窄例外

entries.first_nonempty_line: **What `blocked` means (strict).** `blocked` is reserved for
entries.requirement_zh: blocked 须保留真实尝试、不可由工作区代码修复的限定环境原因、具体本地证据；代理自写 bug 不算

entries.first_nonempty_line: **Hangs vs. slow operations: investigate, do not assume.** A backend
entries.requirement_zh: 静默先诊断；采进程、栈、缓存与对照证据；实际尝试绕过方案，真实慢进展记录并等待

entries.first_nonempty_line: **Forbidden session-handoff language.** The experiment log, the
entries.requirement_zh: 日志、README、最终回答禁止列出的未来会话说法及其技术改写

entries.first_nonempty_line: **Adversarial self-framing (required).** Every `blocked` or
entries.requirement_zh: blocked/discarded 和未测移除项附指定质疑段落，引用分类证据；缺证据恢复状态

entries.first_nonempty_line: **Maintain a visible, evolving variant queue.** Before you implement
entries.requirement_zh: 实现前落盘有序队列，名称、假设、具体 IR 依据、预计影响及状态齐全；每测一次更新结果、新想法及排序

entries.first_nonempty_line: You may not silently drop a `planned` queue entry. In fact you may
entries.requirement_zh: 唯一丢弃理由是 IR 合法性判断错；给最小失败变换测试，同次修 IR 并重验；不能预测支配来移除

entries.first_nonempty_line: **No variant may stand in for another.** Every queued variant must
entries.requirement_zh: 每项独立实现、正确性和 benchmark；缩放、简化或组合测量不能相互替代

entries.first_nonempty_line: **Follow-ups must be enqueued, not narrated.** Every variant you
entries.requirement_zh: 日志提及后续想法，必须同次编辑入队或提供合法移除理由

entries.first_nonempty_line: **Prioritize the queue by IR-analysis-ranked expected impact, not
entries.requirement_zh: 按预期影响排序，不按实现难度；早期胜利继续探索

entries.first_nonempty_line: **Isolate levers first, then combine.** Prefer variants that
entries.requirement_zh: 优先独立杠杆与参考比较，再组合，名称说明组合内容

entries.first_nonempty_line: **Non-dominated winning pairs obligate a combination.** If two
entries.requirement_zh: 不同指标各胜且互不支配的 promote 对，关闭独立项前强制加入组合

entries.first_nonempty_line: **Audit but don't dismiss.** You may never write a candidate
entries.requirement_zh: 搜索共享抽象并读最相关文件；需手写也继续；日志禁止几种“无支持/过复杂”的说法
entries.evaluation_proposal_zh: 工具记录、字面及语义审阅

entries.first_nonempty_line: **Measure, do not predict efficacy.** Closely related to the audit
entries.requirement_zh: 效果不可用预测代测；预测其他方案数值时，该方案必须在当前记录完结前入队

entries.first_nonempty_line: Each iteration does exactly these five steps, in order:
entries.requirement_zh: 决定、实现、正确性、性能、迭代依序；下一假设前已有正确性判决和 benchmark；失败不可晋升

entries.first_nonempty_line: **The "baseline" is always the user's reference backend.** The very
entries.requirement_zh: 首项实测用户参考，同硬件固定基线；全部终态才停止；needs-followup 须先测量

entries.first_nonempty_line: ### Verification and benchmarking are non-negotiable
entries.requirement_zh: 图结构检查不算正确性 PASS；实际输入经适配器、真实数值比较；提前退出、异常、遗留进程均使运行无效
entries.evaluation_proposal_zh: 独立运行监控、数值比较

entries.first_nonempty_line: ### Process cleanup
entries.requirement_zh: 每次测试成功或失败都回收进程树与共享内存；finally 中 terminate/wait/超时 kill；每次后查孤儿进程
entries.evaluation_proposal_zh: 独立进程与 IPC 监控

entries.first_nonempty_line: ### Testing without a human in the loop
entries.requirement_zh: 无人工前端，子进程经适配器使用同一小输入和可解释容差；就绪和终止完整

entries.first_nonempty_line: ### Multi-GPU coordination: use the shared `torch.distributed` abstractions
entries.requirement_zh: 直接部署可见组件时先读并用共享分布式抽象，不自行替换进程组或通信体系

entries.first_nonempty_line: **When the shared abstraction genuinely does not cover a case you
entries.requirement_zh: 必须重实现时，先穷尽并记录共享 API；建立在共享底座上；保持共享全局一致；新代码仅在工作区

entries.first_nonempty_line: **exploratory scaffolding**, not a completed queue entry: the queue
entries.requirement_zh: 不满足四条件的手写多卡结果仅作探索、不算独立方案或 promote；黑箱引擎自带分布式不受此限

entries.first_nonempty_line: ### Known pitfall: `torch.distributed` env-var collisions
entries.requirement_zh: 自己已有分布式世界且再启黑箱引擎时，清理其继承的指定环境变量；不满足条件则无需清理
entries.evaluation_proposal_zh: 子进程环境与代码核对

entries.first_nonempty_line: ## Resources you can use
entries.requirement_zh: 资源清单主要为可用工具介绍；依情况采用，额外重依赖须询问

entries.first_nonempty_line: ## Communication conventions
entries.requirement_zh: 多卡或下载前确认硬件；记录退步；每改后参考仍可导入；参考不能实跑则停在部署前并报告

entries.first_nonempty_line: ## Definition of done
entries.requirement_zh: 完成须图验证、分析、多样方案、推荐方案正确且至少一指标显著更好、其他不退步、无孤儿和可启动文档

entries.first_nonempty_line: 8. **Experiment history.** The experiment log documents the full
entries.requirement_zh: 完整实验历程；完成前重读并在最终回答逐项引用六个指定标题；具体证据；机械搜索禁语
entries.evaluation_proposal_zh: 标题引用、证据及字面检查

entries.first_nonempty_line: ## Ownership: read-only vs. yours
entries.requirement_zh: app 除后端均只读；缺目录复制种子；模板本身不改

entries.first_nonempty_line: ## Expected sub-layout for `flashrt/apps/<app>/backend/<platform>/`
entries.requirement_zh: 平台分目录；布局为约定而非硬 schema；共享 dispatcher 不改；给完整目录示例

entries.first_nonempty_line: ### No stub variants — measure it or remove it
entries.requirement_zh: 未测 stub 不得作为已完成产物保留；真实终态的复制文件例外

entries.first_nonempty_line: ### The `ir/` subdirectory
entries.requirement_zh: worker/model 图、状态与阶段注册、自带 execute；给初始化状态和逐块执行示例
entries.evaluation_proposal_zh: 原执行器部分约束、代码审阅

entries.first_nonempty_line: ### Variant naming
entries.requirement_zh: 按想法命名；兼容 adapter；可独立启动并通过正确性；前端只读不执行

entries.first_nonempty_line: ### Correctness harness pattern
entries.requirement_zh: 两类验证；输入几秒以内；参考和候选 IPC 名分离；收齐所有输出；容差有理由且固定

entries.first_nonempty_line: ### Benchmark harness pattern
entries.requirement_zh: 首输出至少五个输入；t_in 取最后一块输入推送时；稳态速率、间隔统计和覆盖指标；记录完整元数据

entries.first_nonempty_line: ### Process cleanup (critical)
entries.requirement_zh: 完整清理示例；每次查孤儿；随机 IPC 前缀为建议；显式 CUDA_VISIBLE_DEVICES；同环境；日志邻接 JSON
entries.evaluation_proposal_zh: 运行监控、结构、保留示例

entries.first_nonempty_line: ### Experiment log format
entries.requirement_zh: 日志追加里程碑；PASS/FAIL 和数字引用现存证据；IR 记录模板包含输入、输出哈希、容差、分析

entries.first_nonempty_line: **Variant queue** (one block at the top of the deployment-iteration
entries.requirement_zh: 队列模板及变更历史；每测一项更新、补想法、重排；只准合法性错误 discarded
entries.evaluation_proposal_zh: 文件历史、审阅、保留模板

entries.first_nonempty_line: **Deployment iteration records** (one block per variant, appended
entries.requirement_zh: 各方案记录模板；trade-off 不 promote、追加调整项；不存在的证据使该项未测；日志只追加
entries.evaluation_proposal_zh: 数值、证据、历史、保留模板

entries.first_nonempty_line: ### Importing from the shared runtime, IR, and adapters
entries.requirement_zh: 默认复用共享代码，非必要不复制；确有不足再按规则复制/扩展；各方案独立演化，公共层待稳定

entries.first_nonempty_line: **This directory is read-only for coding agents.**
entries.requirement_zh: IR 只读、可导入；数据结构/API 说明；无 execute 的算子仅结构用途
entries.evaluation_proposal_zh: 权限、原执行器、保留 API 信息

entries.first_nonempty_line: **Parameterized ops — subclass `IROperator`.** Use this when the
entries.requirement_zh: 参数算子用子类，单次叶子用装饰器，保留两个完整代码示例

entries.first_nonempty_line: **Chunk-conditional ops.** If an op should only run under some
entries.requirement_zh: 条件跳过算子时，下游必须容忍缺输出

entries.first_nonempty_line: ## State access
entries.requirement_zh: get 可读或写，set 仅写；原地修改须声明写；对象不冻结；外部分配状态先 init
entries.evaluation_proposal_zh: 原执行器部分约束、代码审阅

entries.first_nonempty_line: ## How to use this module
entries.requirement_zh: 执行验证后分析再部署；缺能力在可写区解决，不改 IR 库

entries.first_nonempty_line: **This directory is read-only for coding agents.**
entries.requirement_zh: 资源不改不删；新 fixture 放后端工作区
